data.description:
## Context / Problem
Plan review dominates LLM spend: 2,683 reviews across 779 tickets (~66,000 LLM calls, ~26.5 calls/review), 71% re-runs. Analysis on ticket 696a-82a4-47c5-4e54 (papyral-scarlet-malamute) identified and the operator approved a program of changes that cut token spend without weakening gate outcomes: reuse paths, pre-LLM short-circuits, cache efficiency, criterion gating/calibration, instrumentation, and author-side ergonomics. All items are evidence-backed from the sidecar corpus and backtests recorded on 696a.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Every child ticket below is closed with its change landed through Gerrit (checked: all children report status closed and their rebar-ticket commits are reachable from origin/main).
- [ ] Plan-review coverage metrics report token totals including Pass-1 after the instrumentation child lands (checked: a fresh review-plan run's sidecar coverage.metrics carries input/output/cache token counts).
- [ ] No gate weakening: the criteria enabled for blocking (T3, T10, T5c HIGH, G7 contradicts_reality) use the operator-approved thresholds, and all previously blocking criteria remain blocking (checked: criteria_routing.json diff review).

## Decomposition
Bugs (gate-exempt, claimable immediately): BLOCK-verdict reuse; docs-reviewer surfacing; T1 web grounding.
Independent stories/tasks: DET-block short-circuit; clarity floor additions; edit/claim --review flags; Pass-1 usage instrumentation; optional genai-prices costing; DET triggers for zero-finding criteria; T11 portable constraint; coaching moves in the guide.
Chained by file overlap: pass1.py/passes.py chain = usage instrumentation -> warm-then-fan-out -> shared prefix + exhaustiveness -> mid-review cancellation. criteria_routing.json chain = DET triggers -> T3/T10 blocking -> T5c rewrite -> G7 blocking.
Ordering rationale: instrumentation lands before the cache optimizations it measures; routing-file changes are serialized to avoid textual conflicts; rubric-only and docs-only changes are unordered.
data.title: Token-usage reduction for the LLM gates (evidence-backed program)
